title: Reconnaissance platoon attached to BLT 3/9
placementNote: Pre-July predecessor/background material; chapter coverage must be deliberately decided before publication.

paragraphs.text: A platoon of Company A, 3d Reconnaissance Battalion, landed attached to BLT 3/9. On April 13, the in-country reconnaissance platoons were regrouped as a new Company D.

notes: Source references support the whole proposal; normalized OCR is not a human correction.
